schema_gaps: The LiteratureAtom model is oriented to primary literature and has no dedicated narrative-review synthesis atom kind.
Most review-level mechanistic assertions therefore use atom_kind=other with secondary_source and review_synthesis tags.
Trial-level results summarized by the review are tagged secondary_reported_result and retain provenance to this review, not to the underlying primary studies.
extraction_limitations: The review does not report a reproducible literature-search, study-selection, or risk-of-bias method.
The bibliography was not atomized because citations are provenance infrastructure, not evidence assertions.
The atom set captures the review's main independently reviewable mechanistic, translational, treatment, safety, and conclusion claims. It is not a substitute for primary-study extraction.
All atoms remain review_status=needs_review because this is a secondary source being represented in a primary-literature-oriented schema.
